response.reason: This lens audits the closed FCSTM for structural/contrastive defects against the NL contracts: root initial entry (NL1), PumpControl->PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState containment (NL2), cardinality (NL2-CARD), PumpControl-local initial entry into PumpState only (NL3), sequential transition endpoints PumpState->WaterState (NL4) and WaterState->MethaneState (NL5), and the two derived contracts (PumpState containment, PumpControl declaration). The closed model shows root->PumpControl entry exists and is satisfied; PumpControl contains PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState as siblings (containment satisfied, cardinality exact at 3). But the PumpControl-local initial pseudostate ([*]->InvalidInitialtr_0005/0007/0009) is malformed: it targets synthetic out-of-scope placeholders instead of PumpState directly, and even collectively it does not select PumpState as the unconditional default entry target required by NL3 (there are three competing unconditional edges to three different invalid targets, none of which is PumpState). NL4 and NL5 require literal sequential transitions PumpState->WaterState and WaterState->MethaneState, but the complete transition inventory only contains PumpControl->PumpState, PumpControl->WaterState, PumpControl->MethaneState (parallel branches from PumpControl), and PumpState->exit, WaterState->exit, MethaneState->exit (to invalid final placeholders). No edge exists with source PumpState targeting WaterState, nor source WaterState targeting MethaneState: this is a complete-inventory absence, yielding wrong_target S2 candidates for both NL4 and NL5. This reflects the model implementing three independent parallel modes (matching each substate's own state box in PlantUML with its own initial/final) rather than the NL's single sequential composite, which is a structural inconsistency (three separate PumpControl definitions/[*]->X regions merged into one composite by the compiler, each contributing a synthetic initial/final without an authored PumpState->WaterState or WaterState->MethaneState edge). All containment/cardinality/root-entry/declaration contracts close as satisfied.

output.reason: This lens audits the closed FCSTM for structural/contrastive defects against the NL contracts: root initial entry (NL1), PumpControl->PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState containment (NL2), cardinality (NL2-CARD), PumpControl-local initial entry into PumpState only (NL3), sequential transition endpoints PumpState->WaterState (NL4) and WaterState->MethaneState (NL5), and the two derived contracts (PumpState containment, PumpControl declaration). The closed model shows root->PumpControl entry exists and is satisfied; PumpControl contains PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState as siblings (containment satisfied, cardinality exact at 3). But the PumpControl-local initial pseudostate ([*]->InvalidInitialtr_0005/0007/0009) is malformed: it targets synthetic out-of-scope placeholders instead of PumpState directly, and even collectively it does not select PumpState as the unconditional default entry target required by NL3 (there are three competing unconditional edges to three different invalid targets, none of which is PumpState). NL4 and NL5 require literal sequential transitions PumpState->WaterState and WaterState->MethaneState, but the complete transition inventory only contains PumpControl->PumpState, PumpControl->WaterState, PumpControl->MethaneState (parallel branches from PumpControl), and PumpState->exit, WaterState->exit, MethaneState->exit (to invalid final placeholders). No edge exists with source PumpState targeting WaterState, nor source WaterState targeting MethaneState: this is a complete-inventory absence, yielding wrong_target S2 candidates for both NL4 and NL5. This reflects the model implementing three independent parallel modes (matching each substate's own state box in PlantUML with its own initial/final) rather than the NL's single sequential composite, which is a structural inconsistency (three separate PumpControl definitions/[*]->X regions merged into one composite by the compiler, each contributing a synthetic initial/final without an authored PumpState->WaterState or WaterState->MethaneState edge). All containment/cardinality/root-entry/declaration contracts close as satisfied.
